about: Which settings each service of the split layout gets (v3 Phase 7, decision 0010). env-from-ssm.sh writes state/env/<service>.env from Parameter Store's /job-agent/env/ by the settings map below, and refuses a parameter it does not list. .env (the one-process app, the backup container, and compose's own names) is written in full as before. test/secrets-matrix.test.js holds this file to the code: every setting the code reads is listed here, under settings, fixed, or local.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.why: the owner's Claude key: the api's short calls (draft, revise, letter check, Help), the ai pool, and the inbox's classification (io)

AUTH_MODE.why: google on the app; the workers and the scheduler refuse to start in the demo's mode

AUTOMATIC_RUNS.why: off schedules nobody's runs (scheduler); the api shows the next runs the same way

DATABASE_URL.why: each service's own login from /job-agent/service/<service>/DATABASE_URL; this one (ja_app) is the one-process app's

DEMO_POSTHOG_HOST.why: the demo's usage counts, passed by compose.yml to the demo only

DEMO_POSTHOG_KEY.why: the demo's usage counts, passed by compose.yml to the demo only

DEMO_SITE_ADDRESS.why: compose.yml's name for the demo (Caddy and the demo)

EMAIL_ADDRESS.why: the owner's address: account notices to the owner (api), the run report and alert emails (io)

EMAIL_ENC_KEY.why: seals stored email bodies: inbox review (api) and the inbox check (io)

GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN.why: the owner's Gmail: inbox review reads the message (api), the inbox check (io)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.why: the Google client for Gmail, Docs, and Drive

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.why: the Google client for Gmail, Docs, and Drive

GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.why: the owner's Google sign-in: account emails (api), letter and prep Docs (ai), the report and alert emails (io)

MONTHLY_CLAUDE_BUDGET_USD.why: the owner's cap, checked before every Claude call

PUBLIC_URL.why: the app's address: sign-in, and links in alerts and notices

SCHEDULE_BACKUP.why: the backup container's schedule (.env); the app's scheduler skips it on PostgreSQL

SCHEDULE_INBOX.why: the owner's default inbox times until saved (scheduler), shown the same way (api)

SCHEDULE_PIPELINE.why: the default pipeline times until saved (scheduler), shown the same way (api)

SERPER_API_KEY.why: the owner's search key, for the discover step

SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS.why: overrides each role's grace period (server/roles.ts); normally unset

SITE_ADDRESS.why: compose.yml's name for the app (Caddy and the demo's link)

SUPPORT_EMAIL.why: the help address on pages and in emails

TZ.why: the app's time zone (calendar days, schedules)

USER_KEY_SECRET.why: opens users' own Claude keys: saving one (api) and using one (ai, io)

fixed.APP_VERSION: not set in the cloud yet; the worker's row shows none
fixed.DATABASE_TLS: compose: off for the demo's own database only
fixed.GEO_ALLOW: compose: US for the app (api), empty for the demo
fixed.HEALTH_PORT: compose: each worker's and the scheduler's health port

local.PGPASSWORD: tools/backup/pg.ts passes it to PostgreSQL's programs
local.PGSSLMODE: tools/backup/pg.ts passes it to PostgreSQL's programs
local.PGSSLROOTCERT: tools/backup/pg.ts passes it to PostgreSQL's programs
local.PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL: a local browser choice on Windows
